mapper.insert: INSERT INTO incident ( location, picture_url, status, camera_id, create_time, student_id ) VALUES ( #{location}, #{pictureUrl}, 0, #{cameraId}, NOW(), #{studentId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE incident AS i SET i.status = 1 WHERE i.incident_id = #{incidentId}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS incident_date, COUNT(*) AS incident_count FROM incident GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY incident_date DESC
SELECT location, COUNT(*) AS incident_count FROM incident GROUP BY location

SELECT -- 拼接小时时间段（如：08:00-09:00） CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%H'), ':00-', DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(create_time, INTERVAL 1 HOUR), '%H'), ':00' ) AS hour_slot, COUNT(*) AS incident_count -- 总检测数 FROM incident GROUP BY CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%H'), ':00-', DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(create_time, INTERVAL 1 HOUR), '%H'), ':00' ) ORDER BY CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%H'), ':00-', DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(create_time, INTERVAL 1 HOUR), '%H'), ':00' ) ASC;

SELECT IFNULL(s.banji, '未绑定') AS banji, COUNT(*) AS incident_count FROM incident AS i LEFT JOIN student AS s ON i.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY IFNULL(s.banji, '未绑定') ORDER BY incident_count DESC
SELECT c.level, COUNT(*) AS incident_count FROM incident AS i LEFT JOIN camera AS c ON i.camera_id = c.camera_id GROUP BY c.level
